Who we are

JwithKP is a founder-led IT consulting practice based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

Legal entity: JwithKP Technology (IT Consulting).

Website use

This website gives general information about JwithKP’s services and approach, to help you start a business conversation. Please use it lawfully and do not try to disrupt it or break its security. If you find a security problem, see Security Practices.

The free 30-minute call

The first 30-minute call is free and carries no obligation. It is for understanding your situation and telling you honestly what we would do first. It is not legal, tax or compliance advice.

No automatic service agreement

Submitting a contact request, sending an email, or discussing a requirement through the website or on a call does not by itself create a client relationship, a delivery obligation, or a binding contract.

Proposals, scope and fees

Any consulting engagement, implementation work, support arrangement, price or timeline becomes final only when both sides agree the scope, commercial terms and delivery expectations in a written proposal or agreement. Your proposal states the price, whether GST applies and how it is billed.

Changes, cancellation and refunds

Changes to scope, cancellation and refunds are agreed in your written proposal before work starts, so both sides know where they stand.

Software, hardware and subscriptions

Software subscriptions such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or a password manager are billed directly by the vendors and are not part of our fee. They stay subject to the vendors’ own licensing, pricing and terms. You provide the hardware, such as laptops and routers.

Handover

You keep every configuration, runbook and admin access. Credentials are handed over securely at the end of the project.

Estimators, calculators and examples

The IT Cost Estimator, the ROI calculator, the Startup IT Checklist and the example scenarios are planning aids, not quotes or promises. Estimator figures come from vendor list prices read on the date shown, which can change, and from assumptions the page states. ROI results depend on the reductions you enter. Example scenarios are illustrative and are not past client work. We do not promise specific savings, uptime or security outcomes through this website.

Information accuracy

We aim to keep the website practical and current, but service descriptions, examples and technology references are general and may change as business, technical or vendor details change.

Limitation of reliance

Please do not rely on the website alone as a substitute for a full technical review, security assessment, compliance review or project plan. Check recommendations against your own environment and requirements.

Third-party platforms and links

The website may mention or link to external tools, brands and platforms for information. Those products and sites belong to their owners and are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

Ownership of website content

The content of this website belongs to JwithKP or its licensors. Third-party names and logos belong to their owners. You are welcome to link to our pages and to quote short extracts with credit. Please ask before copying more.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms as our services or the law change. The effective date at the top shows when they were last updated. A signed proposal or agreement keeps the terms it was signed under.

Contact

For business enquiries or questions about these terms, contact JwithKP at info@jwithkp.com or call +91 79829 12207. Our handling of personal data is explained in the Privacy Policy.
